props.heading: Let’s talk
props.lead: Whether you are planning a single room or a whole building, we would love to hear about it.

props.heading: Get in touch
props.lead: The quickest way to reach us is by email or phone. We reply to every enquiry within two working days.

props.heading: Frequently asked questions
props.lead: Cannot find what you are looking for? Get in touch and we will be happy to help.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Most design projects take six to ten weeks from the first meeting to final drawings. We agree a schedule with you at the start.

items.question: Do you work outside the local area?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly work across the region and can arrange remote consultations for early planning.

items.question: How are your fees calculated?
items.answer: We quote a fixed fee for each stage once we understand the scope, so you always know the cost before work begins.

items.question: Can you recommend builders?
items.answer: We work with a small group of trusted contractors and are happy to introduce them, or to work with your own builder.
